agent_position: build the continuation and declare per-period servicing once the two payments-service capabilities land, treating them as required (option A)
owner_disposition: B2: build and close out in full, keep the product dark until the service provides what the guarantee needs; a follow-on turns it on
summary: dark posture over waiting on the service

agent_position: two required service capabilities: an effective-time payee stop and a post-stop refund entitlement
owner_disposition: revises design D1: the one required capability is a payee-advanced billing horizon that lapses billing with the lease; the stop and refund become welcome
summary: horizon instead of two corrections (round 4, F1 B)

agent_position: The last ledger disposition still requires a payee-advanced horizon.
owner_disposition: revises design D1: reject the payee-advanced billing horizon; buyer protection is its own stop and a case over held earnings, with cooperative seller exceptional_end. Keep hosted enablement in the activation change.
summary: Authority-backed buyer protection replaces horizon; see foundation design D8/D12.

agent_position: The plan relied on an exposure_seconds codec/config gate and inconsistent exposure-tail settlement.
owner_disposition: Each party has one notice_seconds on its stop entitlement. Retire exposure_seconds and stop+exposure. Started-period treatment is a per-stopper payment term computed by the authority, never corrected by a storefront end refund.
summary: One notice and authority-calculated partial-period terms.

agent_position: The previous design ended on a stale local funding timer before fresh authority classification.
owner_disposition: E-G: read payments before ending. Verified exhaustion supplies an authority end without classification, renewal replaces the timer, and only unreachable/unverifiable authority ends on the bare timer.
summary: Bounded expiry read prevents last-poll top-up loss.

agent_position: The prior design routed exceptional_end through dispute self-filing and recovered by case discovery.
owner_disposition: revises 02-design-external F15: E-C makes exceptional_end payment-adapter self-correction with the same triggers, timing and journaling; no exceptional_end case or mechanical ruling. Recommend retained seller export and immutable command envelope, with shared payment-effect identity and qualified overlap reconciliation.
summary: Stateless recovery consumes seller evidence and payment effects, not self-penalty cases.

agent_position: The prior plan left a buyer sending only end_delivery paying until its own authority stop.
owner_disposition: E-B/E-E: end_delivery has no at; storefront signs receipt time, ends delivery then and journals a payment stop for receipt plus payer notice/treatment, retrying through outage and optionally waiving notice. E-D leaves buyer_end to human triage.
summary: Cooperative delivery end has a journaled seller billing action.

agent_position: The plan assumed implicit beneficial payee actions, optional notice waiver and a payments exceptional_end operation.
owner_disposition: Supersedes E-A/E-C/E-E and prior F6/F11 representations: SCM derives buyer-checked seller PT0S/returned stop entries on every part; correction emits stop {part} plus reverse {part, amount} under existing authorities, never a payments exceptional-end kind/field. No payee notice waiver or payer early release. Cooperative storefront stop uses buyer receipt-plus-notice treatment only where an entry authorizes it; otherwise buyer half stops. On-demand non-preemption is remedied by buyer case/held money/bond, not mandate-enforced. Spot multi-entry support is an unscheduled gated payments dependency; until available emergency waits out seller notice.
summary: Explicit mandate authorizations replace role-beneficial assumptions; spot immediate stop remains gated.

agent_position: Intermediate rounds used payment-adapter self-correction, explicit seller restitution entries, conditional cooperative stops and a spot multi-entry gate.
owner_disposition: FINAL: supersedes E-A/E-C/E-E as amended and the explicit-entry/favourable-stop notes. Seller exceptional_end is a dispute filing journaled with the end, never future-dated; pre-start failures journal now and file at Agreement start. Seller sends no stop/reverse. Mediation only mechanically rules payee self-penalty at least as strong as standard through its PT0S/chosen entry: returned rates now, rate earnings since at, once unserved share by time, full bond once supported. Setup ends at activation; on-demand always returned. Restore dispute intent/request/published mapping. buyer_end is human triage with exact Agreement/deal-hash verification and payer notice/treatment. end_delivery signs receipt evidence only; buyer half stops first or retries journaled same-key stop through outage with billing until landing. Remove seller restitution entry, implicit favourable stop, notice waiver, payer early release, multi-entry dependency and all seller-direct correction. Spot emergency files exceptional_end; on-demand non-preemption is buyer case/held money/bond remedy. Foundation records compound payments termination as deferred until hosted bonds and dispute-authority recording are designed.
summary: Final dispute-recorded package supersedes both direct-payment rounds; offline recovery adopts existing seller cases and qualified revised rulings.
